content: पवित्र {%a.%} [पू-करणे इत्र] .²1 Sacred, holy, sinless, sanctified (persons or things); त्रीणि श्राद्धे पवित्राणि दौहित्रः कुतपस्तिलाः <ls>Ms. 3. 235</ls>; पवित्रो नरः, पवित्रं स्थानम् <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Purified by the performance of ceremonial acts (such as sacrifices <ab>&c.</ab>). .²4 Purifying, removing sin. .{@-त्रम्@} .²1 An instrument for cleansing or purifying, such as a sieve or strainer <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Two blades of Kuśa grass used at sacrifices in purifying and sprinkling ghee; <ls>N. 17. 188</ls>. .²3 A ring of Kuśa grass worn on the fourth finger on certain religious occasions; धौताङ्घ्रिपाणिराचम्य सपवित्र उदङ्मुखः <ls>Bhāg. 6. 8. 4</ls>. .²4 The sacred thread worn by members of the first three castes of the Hindus. .²5 Copper. .²6 Rain. .²7 Water. .²8 Rubbing, cleansing. .²9 A vessel in which the {%arghya%} is presented. .²10 Clarified butter. .²11 Honey. .²12 A purifying prayer. .²13 A means of purifying the mind. .²14 A cloth for straining Soma juice; वायुः पूतः पवित्रेण प्रत्यङ् सोमोऽतिद्रुतः <ls>Ts. 1. 8. 21</ls>. .{@-त्रा@} .²1 The holy basil. .²2 Turmeric (पवित्रीकृ ‘to purify, sanctify’; पवित्रीभू ‘to become pure or holy’).
